function.name: CoroutineManager_co_exit_to
function.description: This function switches the execution from one coroutine to another within the CoroutineManager, passing an argument object to the target coroutine. It also checks if the target coroutine is available and throws an exception if not. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

thisCoroutine.description: The ID of the currently active coroutine. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.

toCoroutine.description: The ID of the coroutine to switch to. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.
